Author: Akari
Name: Market Helper
Punchline: Undercut, list, gather and buy — market board automation end to end.
Description:
Market Helper is an all-in-one market board tool with five tabs:

UNDERCUT — Walk a summoning bell's retainers and undercut every listed item. HQ and NQ are handled separately, your own retainers are matched rather than undercut, per-item overrides and price memory are supported, an obvious troll price is skipped, and mannequin/display items are never touched (if a row can't be verified it is skipped rather than risk delisting it). Closes the bell when it finishes.

LISTER — Build a list (hold CTRL and hover an item, or search) and press Go to list them all. Prices each item at the most common market price, ignoring lone troll listings, against your world, data center or whole region. Per-item stack sizes and list amounts, rolls extra items to the next retainer at the 20-slot cap, and includes a no-touch dry run.

FLIPPER — Compare any marketable item across Japan, America, Europe and Materia via Universalis. Top 10 listings per region, best cross-region flip, and seller/buyer tax modelling.

ITEM GATHERER — Pull designated items off your retainers into your bags, optionally returning your market listings first. Manual withdraw/deposit actions included.

BUYER — Build a shopping list by hand or import a MakePlace furniture list, then SCAN the market per world via Universalis and press SEND to travel with Lifestream and buy across worlds. Every purchase is verified against the game's own confirmation dialog before it is accepted. Listings are bought whole, so by default it never buys a bigger stack than you still need, and a hard sanity ceiling caps the price even with no cap set. If a planned listing has already been bought it chases the next cheapest, on other worlds if needed, until your order is filled. Dry run is on by default.

Open with /markethelp, /market, /mh, or /undercut.
